shared_elements: rows of repeated small signs (boat forms / inscription glyphs)
object held or presented by a figure
justification: Both surfaces show human figures with extended arms accompanied by small repeated signs and a circular/disc motif, but these are the most generic possibilities in any figurative tradition. A depicts scattered, unregistered stick-like standing figures with boats and free-floating circles, while B depicts two carefully proportioned seated figures in profile facing each other over an offering table above ruled bands of script — utterly different scene structure and drawing conventions.
